relevance.rationale: A review (Contemporary Mathematics memorial volume) of Vinogradov's Secondary Calculus: infinite prolongation E subset J^infty of a PDE system, the Cartan distribution C, the diffiety (E, C), horizontal de Rham cohomology, the C-spectral sequence, and the homotopy-theoretic reformulation. QOU's step-9b keystone conj:qdifference-kernel-prolongation-symbol is stated in exactly this vocabulary -- 'the symbol of the jet-prolongation operator J^n E -> J^{n+1} E' -- and neither that block nor prop:jet-filtration-binding-extensive, rem:bond-order-eq-jet-degree-context, nor QOU/Torsion/JetProlongation.lean carries any citation for the prolongation formalism; a corpus grep for 'diffiety', 'Vinogradov', 'secondary calculus' and 'C-spectral' returns only substring false positives ('quaternionic-spectral'). So the paper is the canonical citable source for the language the keystone is phrased in. Deliberately NOT called core and NOT proposed as aid-proof: Vinogradov's setting is prolongation of a nonlinear PDE system, whereas QOU prolongs a Seiberg-Witten connection and then compares against a q-difference module; the symbol-of-prolongation identification the conjecture needs does not follow from anything here, and I have not checked that any diffiety hypothesis holds in the SW setting.

keyResults.locator: Introduction, eqs (0.1)-(0.2) and the definition of the diffiety (E, C); Sec on the C-spectral sequence
keyResults.statement: The infinite prolongation of a PDE system is a submanifold E of J^infty carrying the involutive Cartan distribution C spanned by total derivatives; the pair (E, C) is a diffiety, and differential calculus on the solution space is calculus up to homotopy on the horizontal de Rham algebra, organised by the C-spectral sequence.
keyResults.useForFolio: Gives conj:qdifference-kernel-prolongation-symbol a citable, coordinate-free definition of the prolongation operator J^n -> J^{n+1} and of what 'its symbol' means, which the block currently uses as undefined vocabulary; also backs the jet-degree language of rem:bond-order-eq-jet-degree-context and prop:jet-filtration-binding-extensive.

proposedActions.rationale: Orphan; the folio's keystone binding conjecture is phrased entirely in prolongation/jet vocabulary with no source for it.
conj:qdifference-kernel-prolongation-symbol names 'the symbol of the jet-prolongation operator J^n E -> J^{n+1} E' as the object to be identified; the definition should point somewhere.
